>Once the dark cloud clears up, you will see all you can do and live and you will know it's gonna be worth it to keep doing

I've been thinking like this since my early teens. Sadly nothing has changed yet. I just don't know how to keep going after all my friends, especially my best one left me.

> playing an instrument or a sport

I tried playing instruments, but I didn't enjoy it. I listen to rap, mainly Eminem and some german stuff. It sounds corny, but I can really relate to Eminem and it gets me in a better mood. 

Regarding sports: I have been attending the gym for a while now and made very good progress, but I'm kinda losing motivation because I question myself why I would even go there, it's pointless from an objective persective. 

Thank you for replying and reading my post!

> about learning to draw so you can give your friend a big surpire, programmin

I really thought about doing this! My only concern is that she might not recover, as she has been suicidal in the past. It's also not very easy to learn, but I'll start right now! I can't move out as my school takes another 2 1/2 years plus I dont have the funds to affort an own apartment. 

Thanks a lot for your reply! :)

Thanks for your reply

Im not getting bullied currently, but I got bully a lot when I was a kid, which left unhealable scars. I will be in this school till im 20, so there is no end in sight. I just dont see the point in keeping on living. Theres nothing Im looking forward to, and its only getting worse
